svg.title: Writes never wait for the network. Each write commits to local SQLite and joins the outbox; the queue drains in order when the network returns.
svg.desc: Sarah's phone shows a todo list under a sync bar reading "Online" beside a "Sync now" button, an ONLINE tag, and an empty outbox. Your Supabase project sits on the right. The phone goes offline: its card turns dashed, the wire dims, and the bar reads "Offline". Sarah adds the todo "works on a plane", completes "Walk the dog", and adds "Ship the demo". Each change shows in the list at once and drops a slip into the outbox, which climbs from 0 to 3, while a pending label in the bar counts up to "3 pending". When the network returns, the bar reads "Online" again and one chip, "push · 3 mutations", carries the whole outbox to kizunasync.push. Three verdicts ride back in the order Sarah made the writes: applied, applied, then rejected with RLS_DENIED. Each verdict clears its outbox slot and lowers the pending count until the label disappears. The rejected row leaves the list and a toast reads "Write rejected: RLS_DENIED". The list then returns to rest before the loop starts again.
svg.text: Writes never wait for the network.
Each write commits to local SQLite and joins the outbox; the queue drains in order when the network returns.
